baseline_scope: Exact historical countdown body and baseline from R1327/R1334; not current next and not a publication candidate.
hypothesis: Long NOPs with repeated prefixes on frequently traversed padding intervals contribute to the reproduced AMD slowdown. Changing only their encoding should alter the body/base timing if this mechanism matters.
hosts: Six independent Ubuntu 24.04 Clang allocations; preserve every observed CPU
controls: all effective instructions and addresses identical
only long NOP byte intervals changed
750000 complete register-output states per variant including aliasing and untouched tails
interpretation: The changed NOPs are a causal intervention. No PMU or hardware-stall mechanism is inferred from instruction count alone.
